item.text:
You’re right: the code fails the docs’ own example.

[The docs state](/Users/yousefallaban/MyProjects/scrubjay-example/docs/behavior/returns/submit-return.md:10):
> The refund is the price paid for the returned items, with the order's discount applied and rounded half up to the cent

[The code](/Users/yousefallaban/MyProjects/scrubjay-example/src/returns.ts:24) uses:
```ts
Math.round(subtotal * (1 - order.discountPercent / 100))
```

For **8.50 with 33% off**, floating-point arithmetic produces `569.49999999999989` cents. I reproduced an actual refund of **5.69**, whereas decimal half-up rounding requires **5.70**.

All 14 existing tests pass; the refund tests miss this boundary. I can start a spec to correct the calculation and add a regression test.
